create_render_context: create a render context for MJX Warp simulation with a MuJoCo model and number of worlds
create_render_context_multi_device: create a render context for MJX Warp across multiple GPU devices
create_render_context_default_device: create a render context for MJX Warp using the default device when no devices are specified
create_render_context_with_kwargs: create a render context for MJX Warp passing additional keyword arguments to mujoco_warp
create_render_context_return_render_cont: create a render context and return a RenderContext object with key, contexts, and default attributes
